reference_sql:
SELECT promo_type,
       CASE WHEN discount_pct >= 40 THEN 'deep'
            WHEN discount_pct >= 20 THEN 'medium'
            ELSE 'light'
       END AS depth,
       COUNT(*) AS n_promotions
FROM promotions
GROUP BY promo_type, depth
